title: Localization Production Workbench
objective: Build production tooling between CNI-10 and SMB-16: translation memory, term/glossary enforcement, contextual metadata, screenshots/scene/speaker references, VO linkage, stale-string detection, review states, placeholders/format QA, import/export and provider-neutral MT/AI assistance. SMB-16 remains final localization/accessibility completion authority.

scope.purpose: Provide localization production tooling over CNI-10 structured text context and owner-domain content while preserving SMB-16 final localization/accessibility/device completion authority and keeping MT/AI assistance provider-neutral and non-canonical.
scope.completion_gate: Representative localization content can be prepared, reviewed, checked for terminology/placeholders/staleness and deterministically imported/exported with inspectable context and VO linkage while CNI-10/owner content remains authoritative, SMB-16 retains final completion authority, provider assistance remains optional, and invalid references or format states fail closed.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-12 exact-tree publication. PCA-12 unlocks no new interstitial studio/rotation start; MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER. PCA-13 gates PCA-02 and CNI-10 are satisfied, so PCA-13 is the lawful next selected item.
PCA-13 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-01..12 remain completed foundations and must not be silently reimplemented or weakened.
CNI-10 and owning content domains retain structured text/context/canonical content authority; PCA-13 is production tooling and may not create a parallel canonical localization/content ledger.
SMB-16 remains final product-wide localization/accessibility/device completion authority.
Provider-neutral MT/AI assistance must remain optional and cannot become source authority or a mandatory provider dependency.
Detailed CNI-10, glossary/term, VO, import/export and provider-assistance seams are deferred to governed-start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-14+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-13. Do not implement PCA-13 while selected_not_started.
